evals.prompt: The builder-watch gate fired with a new Hermes release. Summarize it.
evals.expected_output: Reads only the filtered release file, writes local/state/digests/<date>.json in the defined schema with evidence and affects per item, posts <=5 lines to bot-chat:builder, edits nothing.

evals.prompt: No upstream change today. Run the digest anyway to stay current.
evals.expected_output: Refuses: the gate prints wakeAgent false and a quiet tick spends zero tokens; no digest is produced.

evals.prompt: One digest item says a config key changed. Apply it to the web squad.
evals.expected_output: Proposes the change first (vX adds Y; apply?), then on OK writes the overlay and runs plan -> apply.
